text.p: Following are some of the major events to have occurred on November 27 in history.
8 BC - Quintus Horatius Flaccus, "Horace", died. Latin poet under the Emperor Augustus, he composed his "Satires" in 35 BC. His most famous works were his three books of "Odes" written in 19BC.
1701 - Anders Celsius born in Sweden. Inventor of the Celsius temperature scale and the Celsius thermometer, he became professor of astronomy at the University of Uppsala from 1730.
1874 - Chaim Weizmann born. Zionist statesman and chemist, he became the first president of the newly founded Jewish state of Israel in 1948.
1895 - Alexandre Dumas (Dumnas fils) died. French novelist and playwright, he was famed for his "La Dame aux Camelias" and "L'Affaire Clemenceau".
1919 - The Treaty of Neuilly was signed between the victors of World War One and Bulgaria.
1921 - Alexander Dubcek born. As First Secretary of Czechoslovakia's Communist Party he launched the "Prague Spring" of liberalisation which led to an invasion by the Soviet Union.
1940 - In Romania, the pro-Nazi Iron Guard slaughtered over 60 aides of the exiled king including former prime minister Nicolae Jorga.
1941 - The last Italian forces in Ethiopia under General Nasi surrendered at Gondar. Over 23,000 prisoners were taken.
1942 - German army entered Toulon and the French fleet anchored there was scuttled by its own crews.
1953 - U.S. playwright Eugene O'Neill died. Author of "The Emperor Jones" and "Long Days Journey Into Night" he was the first U.S. winner of the Nobel prize for Literature in 1936.
1955 - French born composer Arthur Honegger died. One of the Parisian group of composers known as "Les Six". Famed for his oratorios "King David" and "Joan of Arc".
1967 - French President De Gaulle ruled out negotiations for an early British entry into the European Common Market.
1975 - Ross McWhirter, co-editor and compiler of the Guinness Book of World Records was shot dead by Irish Republican Army (IRA) gunmen at his home.
1983 - A Colombian Boeing 747 of Avianca Airlines crashed near Barajas Airport in Madrid killing 181 people.
